name: watchlist list over a brand close
looks: A claim and a two-column list of ticker rows (icon, name, a small sparkline control) sit over a dark field; the frame then cross-fades to a wall of softly blurred overlapping UI panels in gentle 3D depth behind the centred logo, a beta tag, a tagline, and the same section labels as a thin nav row beneath.
build: The list rows stagger in on a short fade-and-rise; the close reuses wordmark-assemble's settle stage, with a cinematic-atmosphere-hold-style blurred parallax wall of UI panels drifting slowly behind it for depth.
sound: A soft tick per row, a quiet pad swell under the close.
prompt: Show a two-column list of tracked items staggering into place, each with a small live indicator. Wipe to a closing card: the logo and tagline centred over a wall of softly blurred, overlapping interface panels drifting slowly behind them for depth, with a thin row of the film's section labels beneath as a final nav strip.
